what: The 1px line under the ”See more ▸” link retracts to the right end and vanishes on hover (the target width is below 0, so it finishes at about .18s, around .9 of the .4s curve), and on release it is drawn again from the left

options.--fx-back: Length of the redraw after lifting the hand (via style), same as the default --fx-dur — brand 1.6s (clears in .5s)
options.look: vertical: Vertical-text link — the left vertical line retracts toward the bottom (a room’s ‹View details›)
options.--fx-gone: Folded end width (via style), default calc(0.1% - 24px) (below 0, so it fully folds before the curve ends). At 0% it folds exactly at the end of the length
options.look: return: Return shape: a line retracted to the right regrows from the same right end on release and is drawn out to the left (the line is drawn on the element background and the line child is hidden, --fx-gone is not used) · brand underline link
options.look: scale: Walks away with transform instead of width. On hover it scales to scale3d(0,1,1) with the right end as the pivot, and on release it is drawn again with the left end as the pivot (the original swaps transform-origin and scales away · Brand .5s ease). --fx-gone is not used
options.--fx-line-w · --fx-line-x: In look: scale, line width · offset from the left (via style), default 100% · 0 — to put a short horizontal line to the right of text, calc(100% - 158px)
options.look: flow: Flowing type — the moment you hover, the line sweeps away to the right end and is immediately redrawn from the left, one lap (first half and second half of --fx-dur, default .6s) run once, and it stays drawn. It stays the same on release (original view more 3px underline)
options.--fx-weight · --fx-offset: look: line thickness in flow · offset below the text (via style), default 1px · 0 — brand 3px · 6px
options.look: relay: Relay style — the line doesn’t wipe away or shrink but slides out whole to the right, leaves one width empty, then a new line slides in from beyond the left edge and settles (a 400%-width striped background pushed from 100% → 0 · --fx-dur default .9s · --fx-ease default cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1), so the exit is fast and the entrance is slow). On release it snaps straight back in place (it’s the same shape anyway). Thickness --fx-weight (default 2px), color --fx-line (default text color). White button underline and banner underline (Brand button 900ms, book banner 1000ms cubic-bezier(.87,0,.13,1))
options.look: bar: Bar type — look: loops around like flow, but animates width instead of transform. The line stuck to the right end shrinks to width 0 by 45%, stays empty until 55%, then grows again from the left end (--fx-dur, default .5s · ease). For thick colored bars with rounded line ends (category nav) — collapsing with scale would distort the rounded ends. Used together with --fx-line-x · --fx-line-w · --fx-weight · --fx-offset · --fx-radius (default half the weight). Color is --fx-line (default text color)
